name: EPIC 212582961
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 6, 9.9 solar radii and 0.97 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 5,191 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 6, give 0.97 solar masses and 9.9 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,117 K at its surface.
